page_title: WOL 0-1 RBL | Wolfsburg v RB Leipzig 27/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Robin Braun has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' Substitution. Christoph Baumgartner is replaced by Timo Werner (RB Leipzig).
90+3' Ole Werner prepares a substitution. Johan Bakayoko is replaced by Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig).
90+1' Here is a change. Kilian Fischer is going off and Paul Simonis gives the last tactical orders to Aaron Zehnter (Wolfsburg).
90+1' We are about to witness a substitution. Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) is replacing Vini Souza.
90+1' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) misses the penalty. His shot goes just wide of the right post.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) is cautioned by the referee.
89' It’s a PENALTY to RB Leipzig after the VAR review!
87' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) picks up a sweet pass and fires one in from distance low towards the middle of the goal, but Peter Gulacsi is alert and makes a decent save.
87' Neat passing move from Wolfsburg in order to create new attacking opportunities.

83' A lofted pass to the edge of the six-yard box is won in the air by Adam Daghim (Wolfsburg), but his tame header goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
81' Wolfsburg enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
80' The attendance for today's match is 23236.
79' Ole Werner decides to make a substitution. Yan Diomande will be replaced by Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig).
79' Today's match ends for Romulo Cardoso who will be replaced by Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig).
75' Wolfsburg have been awarded a corner kick.

75' Wolfsburg have a corner. Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg) has a good opportunity as he meets a cross on the edge of the six-yard box and heads it towards the target. One of the defenders stands on the goal line and manages to keep the ball out.
73' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes it short.

72' Ezechiel Banzuzi (RB Leipzig) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Good work from RB Leipzig as they win a corner.
72' Flag up against Johan Bakayoko (RB Leipzig). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
71' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by David Raum (RB Leipzig).
70' Paul Simonis has decided to substitute Jonas Wind and he is replaced by Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg).
70' That will be all from Mattias Svanberg who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg).

69' David Raum (RB Leipzig) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
68' The RB Leipzig players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

66' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Kamil Grabara pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
64' Here's the change. Assan Ouedraogo leaves the pitch and Ezechiel Banzuzi (RB Leipzig) comes on as a substitute.

64' Johan Bakayoko (RB Leipzig) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
60' David Raum (RB Leipzig) wastes a big chance! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box and it goes narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
58' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) infringed the rules and goes into the book. Robin Braun pulls out a yellow card.

58' That's unlucky! Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.

56' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) was the quickest one to orientate himself inside the box and leaps to connect with a cross from the corner kick. He produces a fine header, but it flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
56' There's an opportunity for Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
54' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) rises high to meet a cross on the edge of the 6-yard box and powers his header on goal, but the goalkeeper shows his agility and makes a save.

53' Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Robin Braun blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. A free kick has been awarded to Wolfsburg.

51' What a great effort! Adam Daghim (Wolfsburg) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches over the crossbar. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
51' Robin Braun blows his whistle and signals a foul after David Raum (RB Leipzig) brought his opponent down. It's a free kick to Wolfsburg in a dangerous position.
48' Johan Bakayoko (RB Leipzig) fires a rebound from mid-range onto the bar! The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
48' David Raum (RB Leipzig) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
48' Assan Ouedraogo (RB Leipzig) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. RB Leipzig earn a corner.
47' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) hits a good looking first-time shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
46' Patrick Wimmer will be replaced by Adam Daghim (Wolfsburg).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Robin Braun has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from RB Leipzig.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' It's a yellow card for Willi Orban (RB Leipzig).
41' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
41' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Wolfsburg.
39' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
38' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
37' Wolfsburg are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
35' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
35' RB Leipzig will have a chance to score from a corner kick. A first-time shot by Johan Bakayoko (RB Leipzig) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by one of his own players.
32' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
29' The Wolfsburg players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
27' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Wolfsburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
24' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
22' David Raum (RB Leipzig) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
21' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
20' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent. The referee signals a corner kick to Wolfsburg.
18' Wolfsburg seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

16' My Gran could have done better! Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) got himself in a great position on the edge of the box after a pass, but put his shot well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.

14' Yan Diomande plays a short pass through to Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) inside the box, but he scuffs his effort well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
11' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes a short corner kick.
11' The resulting corner comes to nothing as David Raum (RB Leipzig) sends it out of play.
9' Good movement by Johan Bakayoko (RB Leipzig), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball is behind the touchline and Wolfsburg will take a throw-in.
8' 0 - 1 Goal! Romulo Cardoso plays a long ball to Johan Bakayoko (RB Leipzig), who cuts inside and unleashes a screamer into the bottom right corner. The keeper had no chance. Superb strike! 0:1.
7' Johan Bakayoko (RB Leipzig) sends a cross into the box, but Kamil Grabara comes off his line to gather the ball.
6' RB Leipzig have a goal ruled out for offside!
5' RB Leipzig work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
4' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

4' Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) takes a first-time shot inside the box after latching onto a nice lofted pass, but the effort is blocked and spins away to safety. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Wolfsburg.
3' Poor challenge! Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) is penalised for tripping and Robin Braun blows his whistle. Wolfsburg are awarded a free kick.
1' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Peter Gulacsi makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
RB Leipzig will kick-off.
Robin Braun got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
